candidate.name: include-issue-pr-links-in-release-notes
candidate.description: Ensure every release note entry explicitly references its source issue or pull request link for traceability.
candidate.when_to_use: Use when drafting, generating, or formatting release notes, changelogs, or update summaries.
candidate.instructions:
1. When writing release notes or changelog entries, do not list changes in isolation.
2. For each bullet point or entry, include the corresponding issue number, pull request reference, or direct link.
3. Ensure the source reference is clearly visible and facilitates traceability back to the original task or discussion.
candidate.evidence: 以后每一条 release notes 都要标注来源 issue/PR 链接，方便追溯，必须注明来源。

decision.reason: Both skills define release note formatting standards; merging links issue/PR traceability directly into the release note bullet point guidelines.
